question: The full form of IBM in IBM Corporation is:
solution:
The correct answer is__** International Business Machines.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IBM Corporation** is one of the world's largest technology and consulting companies, known for its innovation in computing technology.
 
• The full form of IBM stands for **International Business Machines**, reflecting its global outreach and emphasis on business solutions.
 
• Founded in **1911**, IBM originally started as a company that manufactured machinery for business applications.
 
• IBM has played a crucial role in the development of computer technology, including hardware, software, and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Context**: IBM was established as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company (CTR) through the merger of four companies and was renamed International Business Machines in **1924**.
 
• **Product Range**: IBM offers a wide range of products and services, including cloud computing, artificial intelligence, hardware, and software solutions.
 
• **Research and Development**: IBM has a strong focus on R&D, leading to numerous patents and innovations in various fields, including quantum computing.
 
• **Corporate Social Responsibility**: IBM is also known for its commitment to corporate social responsibility and sustainability initiatives worldwide.
